scope: US Ford Expedition incl. Expedition EL (2007-2017) and MAX (2018+), Timberline (2022-2024), Tremor (2025+), Stealth Edition. Lincoln Navigator-only engines (5.4 DOHC, 450-hp EcoBoost) excluded. The SVT Expedition "Thunder" (360-hp 5.4) was a proposal only and never produced.

hp_note: All ratings SAE net. 2018+ EcoBoost ratings on premium fuel (SAE J1349).
